source_read: https://www.parsonsbakery.co.uk/allergens and all 92 product PDFs it links under /s/ (downloaded fresh 2026-10-08, all byte-identical to the earlier saved copies; robots.txt checked with robots_rfc, /s/*.pdf allowed; the 2 dead links answer 404 again; the pay-gap report is not a product)
not_verifiable: 3 image-only 2025 reports (White Chocolate & Raspberry Muffin, Custard Slice, Fruit & Nut Flapjack) and the 2 sauce-sachet files are not published, so nothing to compare; the chain's reports print no may-contain information
notes: Own pdftotext -layout reader (not the script's) of every report: for all 84 published items energy kJ/kcal, fat, saturates, carbs, sugars, protein, salt, fibre (where printed), weight (from a 'per Ng' header) and report date equal items.csv; allergen 'Contains' lines (all columns) equal allergens.csv incl. named cereals, vegetarian marks equal tags, pork/beef tags equal the ingredient text; the only differences are by design (a report listing only 'Contains Oats' or 'Contains Barley' is published as gluten with the named cereal, 11 oat-milk/mocha/hot-chocolate drinks). 9 pages rendered and read (12-row checklist items incl. the three loaves), link text and section on the page match every item name/category (TITLE_WINS names come from the PDF titles); the 2 held-back items are confirmed (Flat White = Decaf White Coffee column for column; Pepperoni Pizza Stick is an 820 g pizza). Marked ok: the three whole-loaf salt flags (loaf figures as printed, FOP panel agrees). Noted only: BBQ Beef Roll's table header reads 'per Each Pork Roll' (template leftover, ingredients list minced beef, no other report has the same numbers); 'Pizza Stick' is linked to a report titled 'Pizza Baguette' dated 19/12/2024 (oldest); Cappuccino and Latte print identical figures. Re-run from the fresh PDFs reproduces data/source byte for byte; check_chain 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 unreviewed audit flags.
